en.name: How AI Works Under the Hood
en.desc: Plain-English visual explainers on Transformers, tokens, embeddings, and how base models are trained.

zh.name: 看懂底层原理
zh.desc: 用直观动画和大白话讲清楚：Transformer 注意力是什么、文字怎么变成数字坐标、大模型是怎么训练出来的。

en.name: New Models, Reasoning & Local AI
en.desc: How reasoning models (DeepSeek-R1, o3) think, plus fine-tuning and running free open models on your own computer.

zh.name: 新模型、慢思考与本地运行
zh.desc: 搞懂 DeepSeek-R1、o3 这类慢思考模型强在哪，以及怎么把免费开源模型装在自己电脑上或按业务做微调。

en.name: Knowledge Bases, Tools & AI Agents
en.desc: Feed clean context, build accurate private search (RAG), connect tools with MCP, write SKILL.md guides, and test output quality.

zh.name: 搭知识库与做智能体
zh.desc: 聚焦最实用的落地技术：喂对背景资料（上下文工程）、搭不瞎编的知识库、用 MCP 连工具、写技能包与自动测准确率。

en.name: AI Coding, Image & Video Workflows
en.desc: Ship software faster with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, or create consistent images, videos, and voiceovers with ComfyUI and Flux.

zh.name: AI 写代码与做图文视频
zh.desc: 一边是用 Claude Code、Cursor 快速写代码做产品；另一边是用 ComfyUI、Flux 做出人物一致的高质量图片、视频和配音。

en.name: Understand How Models Think
en.desc: See how attention, memory cache (KV Cache), and step-by-step reasoning actually work without drowning in equations.

zh.name: 搞懂大模型是怎么思考的
zh.desc: 不推复杂公式，看明白注意力机制、长对话占内存的原因（KV Cache）以及慢思考推理是怎么回事。

en.name: Ask Better & Manage Context
en.desc: Write clear instructions, give good examples, trim messy chat history, and organize project rule files.

zh.name: 怎么提问与喂对背景资料
zh.desc: 把话说清楚、给对参考例子、定期清理过长的聊天废话，让 AI 不跑偏、不漏条件。

en.name: Build Private Docs Q&A (RAG)
en.desc: Let AI answer strictly from your PDFs and internal docs using smart splitting, keyword + vector search, and citations.

zh.name: 搭私有知识库（不瞎编）
zh.desc: 让 AI 严格根据你的 PDF、财报和内部文档回答问题，不确定的直接说不知道，绝不胡编乱造。

en.name: Connect Tools, MCP & Skills
en.desc: Let AI safely read databases, call APIs via MCP, and load step-by-step SKILL.md playbooks on demand.

zh.name: 让 AI 连外部软件、装技能
zh.desc: 给 AI 装上「手和脚」：让它查数据库、连飞书/GitHub（MCP），或者照着你写的 SKILL.md 说明书干活。

en.name: Multi-Step Agents & Browser Automation
en.desc: Build agents that plan steps, click through web pages in a safe sandbox, and split big tasks across helper agents.

zh.name: 让 AI 自动分步干活与操作网页
zh.desc: 设计稳当的自动执行流程、让 AI 帮你点击网页填表，或者派几个小助手分头查资料汇总。

en.name: Build Apps & Write Code with AI
en.desc: Turn ideas into working software with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, AGENTS.md rules, and automatic test checks.

zh.name: 用 AI 写代码、做网页和小产品
zh.desc: 不管你是程序员提效还是产品经理做原型，学会用 Claude Code、Cursor 配合测试脚本稳稳做出可用软件。

en.name: Test Quality, Fine-Tune & Run Locally
en.desc: Catch AI mistakes automatically with pass/fail tests (Evals), fine-tune small models with LoRA, or run models offline with Ollama.

zh.name: 自动测准确率、微调与本地安装
zh.desc: 搭建自动抓错的测试集（Evals）、用少量数据微调专属小模型（LoRA），或者用 Ollama 断网免费跑模型。

en.name: Make Consistent Images, Video & Voice
en.desc: Lock character faces in Flux/ComfyUI, control camera motion in AI video, and generate natural voiceovers.

zh.name: 可控画图、做视频与配音
zh.desc: 告别抽盲盒：用 ComfyUI 和 Flux 锁住主角长相与构图，生成镜头可控的视频和自然人声配音。

en.name: Claude, MCP & SKILL.md
en.desc: Practical guides on Claude, Claude Code in the terminal, MCP connectors, and SKILL.md folders.

zh.name: Claude / MCP / 技能包
zh.desc: 围绕 Claude、终端编程神器 Claude Code、MCP 万能接口与 SKILL.md 技能包的实战经验。

en.name: OpenAI, o3 & Codex
en.desc: OpenAI reasoning models, strict JSON structured outputs, Agents SDK, and Codex coding workflows.

zh.name: OpenAI / o3 / Codex
zh.desc: 涵盖 ChatGPT / o3 推理模型、固定 JSON 格式输出、Agents SDK 与 Codex 自动写代码工具。

en.name: DeepSeek, Qwen & Local Ollama
en.desc: Free open-weight models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama), Unsloth fine-tuning, Ollama desktop setup, and vLLM serving.

zh.name: DeepSeek / Qwen / 本地运行
zh.desc: 免费开源的 DeepSeek、通义千问、Llama 模型，以及用 Ollama、Unsloth 在本地运行和微调。

en.name: Cursor & AI Code Editors
en.desc: Everyday workflows inside Cursor and AI code editors: project rules, multi-file edits, and parallel git branches.

zh.name: Cursor 等 AI 编程软件
zh.desc: 手把手用好 Cursor 等 AI 编辑器：项目规则怎么配、多文件同时改怎么不乱、怎么随时回退。

en.name: LangGraph & Browser Automation
en.desc: LangGraph workflow state machines, PydanticAI, Playwright browser-use agents, and safe code sandboxes.

zh.name: LangGraph 与网页自动化工具
zh.desc: 用 LangGraph、PydanticAI 编排多步流程，以及用 Playwright / Browser-Use 让 AI 自动操作浏览器。

en.name: NotebookLM, Search & Eval Tools
en.desc: NotebookLM research notebooks, hybrid vector/keyword search databases, and Braintrust/Phoenix testing tools.

zh.name: NotebookLM、知识库与评测工具
zh.desc: 包含零门槛的 NotebookLM 资料库、混合搜索数据库，以及用来给 AI 回答自动打分抓错的评测工具。

en.name: ComfyUI, Flux & Video/Voice Tools
en.desc: Node-based ComfyUI workflows, ControlNet pose/depth locking, Flux image gen, AI video, and ElevenLabs voice.

zh.name: ComfyUI / Flux 生图与音视频
zh.desc: 节点式生图神器 ComfyUI、ControlNet 锁动作构图、Flux 高清生图、AI 视频运镜与语音克隆。

en.name: 3Blue1Brown, Stanford & PyTorch
en.desc: World-class visual animations (3Blue1Brown, Welch Labs), Stanford lectures, Karpathy code walkthroughs, and key papers.

zh.name: 经典动画科普、公开课与手写代码
zh.desc: 汇聚 3Blue1Brown 视觉动画、Karpathy 通俗大课、李宏毅/李沐精讲与斯坦福公开课最精华的片段。
